content.introduction: According to the sources, international stock markets showed mixed performance on November 2, 2026. The SMI in Switzerland decreased by 8.14 points (-0.05%), while the BOVESPA in Brazil saw a minor decrease of 85 points (-0.05%). The BSX in Bermuda remained unchanged. The KOSPI in South Korea increased by 128.34 points (+2.24%), and the SENSEX in India rose by 1233.25 points (+1.66%). The S&P 500 dropped by 40.57 points (-0.53%), the NIKKEI 225 in Japan fell by 208.25 points (-0.33%), and the DAX in Germany decreased by 190.10 points (-0.75%). The sources don't provide a definitive answer for today's date, November 3, 2026.
